question: What is the distance between the stumps and the popping crease at the same end of a Cricket pitch?
solution:
The correct answer is.**1. __22m__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• These are the inside edges of the crease markings, which shall be at right angles to the popping crease at a distance of 1.22m (4 feet 4 inches) to either side of an imaginary line joining the centers of the two middle stumps.
 
• The popping crease, which is the back edge of the crease marking, shall be in front of and parallel to the bowling crease and shall be 4 ft/1.22 m from it in total.
 
• The popping crease is in front of and parallel to the bowling crease. It is 1.22m from the bowling crease and is marked to a minimum of 1.83m on either side of the two middle stumps and is unlimited in length.
